title: S2-SD-12 ROCKET BODY RE-ENTRY RISK FALCON 9 CASE STUDY - EXPRO+
description: On February 19, 2025, at around 4:46 a.m. local time, over Polish territory, in the area west of the city of Poznan, an uncontrolled re-entry into the lower layers of Earth's atmosphere occurred involving a stage of the Falcon 9 upper stage. It was followed by the fragmentation of the object and the fall of its parts to the Earth's surface over an area spanning several dozen kilometres.Fortunately, re-entry events where fragments are identified on-ground are rare and when the associate risk does not materialise, they provide a scientific opportunity. Large uncertainties on destructive re-entry physics and dynamics in the very low Earth orbit ( < 150km ) can be constrained by studying the physics associated with the fragment generation and final impact location, as demonstrated by recent studies targeting break-ups recoded by on-ground all-sky telescope systems.The activity aims to maximize the scientific return of the Falcon 9 re-entry event, without usage of proprietary information. This shall be based on constraining the impact trajectory based on available ground recordings, impact points and orbital trajectory data. The likely break-up aerothermodynamics, including ablation is to be assessed and reconstructed. The lesson learned from the analyses shall be used to draw general conclusions onthe re-entry predictability and risk associated with elongated upper stages, including past and future risk assessments for the orbital population, and educational outreach to raise awareness.

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Planungsleistung TGA HLS - ALG 1, 2, 3, 8 - Erweiterung Hauptfeuerwache Potsdam, 14467 Potsdam
description: Der Fachbereich 37 der Landeshauptstadt Potsdam, hier Feuerwehr, benötigt einen Neubau, mit zweigeschossigem Verbinder/Laufgang, zur Bestandswache, auf dem Gelände zwischen Holzmarktstraße und Türkstraße in 14467 Potsdam. Im Zuge einer vorgelagerten Machbarkeitsstudie, wurde der benötigte Bedarf ermittelt und maximale Baugrößen und Randbedingungen identifiziert, mit den beteiligten Ämtern vorabgestimmt und durch diese schriftlich freigegeben. Im Zuge der Planung sollen jedoch noch 3 verschiedene Ansichten der Fassadengestaltung der Denkmalbehörde zur Abstimmung vorgelegt werden. Genehmigungsfähig ist ein Gebäude mit bis zu 4 Geschossen und einer maximalen Höhe von 15 m einschließlich aller technischen Aufbauten. Die ersten beiden Geschosse sind als Parkebene zu planen. Besonderheit im EG ist die benötigte Durchfahrtshöhe von 4,0 m. Gegenstand der Planung sind TGA-Leistungen nach HOAI für die Anlagengruppen Wasser/Abwasser, Wärmeversorgung, Lüftung und Gebäudeautomation.

title: Ireland – Construction work – 9165 Single Supplier Framework Agreement for Design and Build Signalling and Telecoms Contractor for DART +
description: Iarnród Éireann (IÉ) has an existing contract in place for the Long-Term Supply, Installation, Testing, and Commissioning of a Computer-Based Interlocking System (CBIS). As part of the DART+ Programme, IÉ is seeking to appoint an experienced contractor to the DART+ Single Supplier Framework for Design & Build Signalling & Telecoms. The appointed contractor will be responsible for the design, construction, and commissioning of all Signalling and Telecoms works, with the exception of those tasks specifically designated as the responsibility of the interlocking system OEM (Original Equipment manufacturer).For the avoidance of doubt, this framework excludes interlocking system OEM works, which will continue to be delivered under IÉ’s existing CBIS Framework. The DART+ Single Supplier Framework for Design & Build Signalling & Telecoms will include the detailed design, installation, testing and commissioning (as appropriate) of the following: • A new signalling system, including lineside signals, lineside equipment housings, train detection equipment, balise installation, point operating equipment and all associated cabling. • ETCS Level 1 train protection system, designed and provided by the CBI framework supplier, will be installed and commissioned by the appointed S&T Contractor • Alterations as required where the new signalling systems will fringe to existing signalling systems. • Power supply and distribution systems to support S&T equipment, including signalling & telecoms power supply systems. • Points heating systems. • Telecoms systems (including both fibre and copper cabling) to support the signalling system. • Lineside telephones. • The decommissioning of existing level crossings, including the recovery of existing equipment. • The decommissioning and recovery of redundant signalling & telecoms systems and electrical systems. • Ancillary systems for lineside buildings and equipment housings, including lighting, cable management, telecoms connections, environmental control, fire detection and suppression systems, access control and intruder alarm systems. • Collaborating with and supporting, as required, the IÉ appointed Maintainer of the National Traffic Control Centre (NTCC), who will undertake required upgrades to systems (including the Traffic management System) within the NTCC. Similarly, the project shall interface the with existing Connolly Train Control (CTC) centre. Where any existing system is to be retained, immunisation works as required to enable the introduction of overhead Electrification (by others). • Provision of training material to support the briefing and training of drivers, signallers and other operational staff.
